graded_comparison: INTERPRETABLE GSK3A vs GSK3B in CHEMBL4334438 (ratio 1.15, mutant enzymes pooled, wild-type pair 1.67) ; LIMITED in CHEMBL3526091 (1.67) and CHEMBL5653620 (1.67, validity comment); kinase panel in CHEMBL1138659 = PANEL_NOT_SELECTIVITY (CDK4 1.8 uM, CDK2 2.8 uM, PKC beta II 420 nM; descriptive only). Laduviglusib: INTERPRETABLE 1.59 (CHEMBL4020814) and 1.0 (CHEMBL5728885)
criteria_i_ii_iii_iv: (i) PASS (ii) PASS (iii) PASS (iv) PASS: both appear in no deepening or assessment; LY-2090314 is one of the 50 Q7 rows (DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY, hop0), laduviglusib is not in those 50 by name
